references.text: The Lord is a jealous God who punishes the fathers' sin on the children. This verse shares the theme of God's wrath against idolatry.
Moses asks that the Lord's wrath not flare up against the people. Both texts deal with God's burning anger.
Warns that the Lord's wrath will flare up and wipe out the people from the land if they worship other gods.
Warns against turning away to worship other gods, which will lead to the Lord's wrath and swift destruction.
Deals with those who try to lure others into serving foreign gods, the same theme of apostasy.
Describes how the Lord's wrath burned against the land because they abandoned the covenant and worshipped other gods.
Prophesies that the people will turn to foreign gods and that God's wrath will flare up against them.
Joshua warns against marrying into pagan nations, as this will become a snare leading to destruction.
Solomon's foreign wives turned his heart to other gods, fulfilling the warning in Deuteronomy.
Nehemiah rebukes the Israelites for marrying foreign women and points to Solomon's sin as an example.
